terms.meaning: a library that provides drawers which slide up from the bottom of the screen

sections.name: File setup (part 1)
sections.title: Drawer wrapper, overlay and content
sections.what: Wraps the drawer library into a set of parts: the root, trigger, portal, overlay, and content. The content adds a dim background, a rounded top edge, a grip bar, and the child content inside.
sections.why: Gives the app a shared drawer built from the vaul library, styled to match the design.
sections.watch_out: The content part already creates its own overlay and portal, so using it inside another portal can produce a double overlay.

sections.name: File setup (part 2)
sections.title: Header, footer, title and description parts
sections.what: Provides simple layout pieces for the top area, bottom area, title and description of a drawer, with spacing and text styles.
sections.why: Keeps drawer headings and actions consistent with the rest of the design.

sections.name: File setup (part 3)
sections.title: Exported drawer parts
sections.what: Lists all the drawer parts so other files can import them by name.
sections.why: Makes the drawer parts available to pages that need them.
sections.watch_out: Any part not listed here cannot be used by other files, even if it exists in this file.

summary: A second, general-purpose set of drawer parts (sheet from the bottom) with header, footer, title and description pieces.
purpose: Provides building blocks for drawers across the design system.
why: Reason not stated in the code. The overlap with bottom-drawer suggests two drawer styles exist, but the usage is not visible.
how: Wraps the vaul drawer library in named parts: root, trigger, overlay, content, header, footer, title and description. The content shows a small handle bar and sits at the bottom of the screen.
inputs: Props for each part, and the children to show inside.
outputs: Drawer UI when opened. It does not change data.
risks: It overlaps with bottom-drawer. Its overlay is dark at 80 percent, while bottom-drawer uses 40 percent, so the two look different.
debug: If a drawer looks different from others, compare it with bottom-drawer and check which component is imported.
